criteria.original_velocity_criterion: Reported separately under unchanged process_criteria_v1.json; not silently altered. New transfer retention uses measured object/TCP relative pose and bilateral physical support.
criteria.rationale: 2 s continuous physical support, no left/table support, 2 mm relative drift (4% of 50 mm cube width), <=5 deg relative rotation. Exit requires object displacement AND increasing separation from left TCP; no reference handoff coordinate/path. Original 2 mm physical penetration guard unchanged.
